title: Software Engineer
summary: A software engineer writes, tests and maintains code for a product or service in one main language such as Java, Python or C++. It is the main entry route into tech in India, working in a team under senior engineers with code review and stand-ups.
dailyDuties: Write and debug code for assigned features in one main language
Write unit tests for your own code
Build or call REST APIs and handle errors
Write SQL queries and design simple tables
Raise pull requests and respond to code review
Run services and read logs on the command line
